title.value: A Framework for Obtaining Accurate Posteriors of Strong Gravitational Lensing Parameters with Flexible Priors and Implicit Likelihoods using Density Estimation
title.justification: The paper's title matches the provided information and reflects the content and focus of the study.

extractions.description: The paper presents a method for predicting the macro-parameters of strong gravitational lensing systems using implicit likelihood inference and deep learning models. The method enables the imposition of desired priors on lensing variables to obtain accurate posterior distributions. It leverages neural networks to perform regression tasks for estimating lensing parameters and utilizes mixture density networks to model likelihood functions.
